name: Duck Creek Golf Club
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (2945, 2800 Diamond Oaks Dr); its pars and handicaps match OpenStreetMap's hole tags (par 71). Ratings matched to tees by total yards (Back = Black, Middle = White); Gold has none, and the Forward rating is for 5103 yards, not Red's 5019, so Red has none.
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course.
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery; every point is moved by it.
